research_question: Does the same fully tied-row symmetric pressure change strict routing decisions beyond the original SPO+ ensemble implementation?
training_normalization: Keep every training question in the n denominator. Change the fully tied row term only. Apply L2 to all entries including intercept.
main_quality: C minus B in expected deterministic cached accuracy, with exact uniform deployment over the frozen maximum set
primary_mechanism: Number of held-out original questions with two strict argmax actions and different physical identities
utility_reporting: Report signs and point differences, task counts, corrections and damages and source limits. No confidence intervals, CI-only bootstrap or decisions tuned to results.

internal_listnet.role: Cross-loss control in the original model pool on E19 development OOF, not an independent new test
internal_listnet.training_and_evaluation: Frozen E19 train600 five-fold OOF, original three-repeat binary aggregate-reward means, MiniLM/PCA16/StandardScaler, 17x20 head, original per-fold lambda
internal_listnet.objective: Top-one ListNet: KL(softmax(mean rewards)||softmax(q)); subtract target entropy only. Uniform full-tie KL alone is turned off in C. Both temperatures 1.
internal_listnet.point_weight: GSM8K 0.5, BBH 0.5, retain BBH subtask and all seed breakdown

external.role: External six single-model actions; supports mechanism transfer only, not ensemble aggregation or general service gains
external.split: Use official DARS original-question groups with no question or rewrite crossing splits. Binary correctness only, no DROP F1.
external.training_observations: Same first rewrite (prompt_variant_id=0); first three ordered decode_id values for all models, one fixed request configuration. L=1 and L=5 retain the same rewrite and nested first observations.
external.predictor_input: Original question text only, frozen MiniLM-L6 max_length 256, train-fit PCA16 and StandardScaler, intercept, no task/reward metadata. One head per task.
external.first_task_reverse_checks: For both main cells, reverse train label columns and map scores and policies back before evaluating.
external.evaluation: Original query, observation_type=decoding_variation, prompt_variant_id=-1. Primary temperature 0.7. Separately report 0.2 and 1.0 as different fixed configurations, never iid replicates of the primary. All test scores withheld until both tasks' scores and policies are frozen.
external.task_aggregation: Per-task original-question accuracy and equal-task macro. Per-temperature coverage and support counts.
external.baseline: Train-only global fixed model, chosen by L3 mean reward with uniform tie deployment, for context only.

preserved: No use of P2 results for fitting or external selection; no fresh400 or sealed200 access, new LLM/API inference, model-pool changes in original domain, loss/hyperparameter search or automatic P4.
